body:
Adds `research/twin-control-variate`: a digital twin as a control variate for certifying a policy's real cost (scalar LQ). Exact twin/plant correlation, optimal twin-to-real rollout split and speed-up (matched by simulation), bias vs correlation scaling in model error, and the coverage failure of twin-only intervals. Includes tests, reproducible experiments, whitepaper, BibTeX, README bullet and homepage entry (`python site/build.py` prints ok).
